description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into Linear issues. Uses a uuid5 derived from (team_id, key_column value) as Linear's own client-settable IssueCreateInput.id -- the same key always maps to the same issue, so re-runs update rather than duplicate, with no body-marker hack needed.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Linear issue (upserted via key_column).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated). No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Linear.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

team_id.label: Team Id
team_id.description: Target Linear team UUID (required by IssueCreateInput.teamId).

key_column.label: Key Column
key_column.description: Upstream column holding a stable unique key, used to derive a deterministic Linear issue id.

priority_column.label: Priority Column
priority_column.description: Column holding issue priority (0-4 or name: Urgent/High/Medium/Low/No priority).

state_name_column.label: State Name Column
state_name_column.description: Column holding a workflow state name (e.g. 'Done', 'In Progress').

label_names_column.label: Label Names Column
label_names_column.description: Column holding label names. Accepts a list, or a comma-separated string.

default_labels.label: Default Labels
default_labels.description: Label names always applied on top of label_names_column.

assignee_email_column.label: Assignee Email Column
assignee_email_column.description: Column holding an assignee's email, matched against the workspace's users.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows to process per run (safety cap).

name: Linear Issue Upsert
